name: centaur-medical-backend
description: Centaur Medical — Medical Records Management System (backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,auth,patient,notif -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w gateway" "npm run dev -w auth-service" "npm run dev -w patient-service" "npm run dev -w notification-service"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w gateway && npm run build -w auth-service && npm run build -w patient-service && npm run build -w notification-service
scripts.test: npm run test -w auth-service && npm run test -w patient-service && npm run test -w gateway && npm run test -w notification-service
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w auth-service && npm run test:coverage -w patient-service && npm run test:coverage -w gateway
scripts.db:setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
